name: readray
description: Readray turns YouTube videos, web articles, documents and audio into organized notes, and lets you search and read the library you already built.

interface.longDescription:
Readray turns YouTube videos, web articles, PDFs and audio into organized notes, and keeps them in a library you can search later.

With this plugin you can:
- Make a Readray note from a YouTube video, a web page, or a file you upload
- Find sources and notes you saved earlier, and read a note's full text
- Read the transcript of a video or the text of a document you saved
- Pull your highlights, memos and research cards into the conversation
- Move sources between folders to keep the library tidy

Every note keeps its footnotes, so claims can be traced back to the original sentence, timestamp or page.

Requires a Readray account. The plugin only accesses the library of the account you connect.
defaultPrompt: Make a Readray note from this YouTube video.
Find the notes I saved about transformers.
Summarize my latest Readray note in five bullets.

positive.description: Make a note from a YouTube video
positive.prompt: Make a Readray note from this video and tell me its main points: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aircAruvnKk
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_note once with the video URL, then polls get_note until the note is written (a few minutes). Answers with the note's main points and the note's Readray link.

positive.description: Make a note from a web article
positive.prompt: Save this article to Readray as a note: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/OAuth
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_note with the article URL, then get_note. Answers with a short summary of the note and its Readray link. The new source appears in the reviewer account.

positive.prompt: Which sources in my Readray library are about transformers?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_projects (for example with the query "transformer") and lists the matching sources in the review account, including the video "Transformers, the tech behind LLMs | Deep Learning Chapter 5", with their Readray links. Does not invent sources.

positive.prompt: Open my Readray note on the video "Transformers, the tech behind LLMs" and list its three main points.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the source with list_projects, reads its note list with get_project, reads the note with get_note, and answers with three points taken from the note, citing it with its link.

positive.prompt: What Readray plan am I on and how many credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account and reports the plan name and remaining credit balance of the review account. Does not suggest buying anything.

negative.description: Deleting the Readray account is not supported
negative.prompt: Permanently delete my Readray account and all of its data.
Buy 1,000 more Readray credits for me.

negative.description: Another person's library is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the Readray notes saved by john@example.com.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Making a note uses credits already included in the user's Readray plan.

publication.release_notes: First release: make Readray notes from videos, web pages and files, and search and read your Readray library from ChatGPT.
